repository.commit_message: fix(editor): reject malformed saved page records
repository.push: normal fast-forward; no force push, reset, or branch switch

defect_and_fix.reproduction: A saved Editor v2 document can contain a null or primitive page value in document.pages. The validator dereferenced page.id when formatting hierarchy errors, and semantic preflight dereferenced page.nodes, causing a TypeError rather than a controlled invalid-document result.
fix: Document validation now iterates page key/value pairs and uses the key as a safe diagnostic id when a record has no usable id.
Hierarchy validation remains the source of the malformed-page diagnostic; semantic/accessibility preflight skips null, primitive, and array page records so they cannot escape as TypeErrors.
Added regression coverage for null and false persisted page records; validation throws only the controlled invalid-document error and does not rewrite the record.
Extended the real Chromium Editor boot regression to assert a controlled visible load error, no uncaught page errors, no persistence writes, and unchanged malformed data.
Bumped the validation module cache key in Editor commands and state so production clients load the fixed validator.
defect_and_fix.save_publish: Unchanged and separate. Malformed persisted records are neither auto-repaired nor saved/published.
